{{Top|leg}}
A '''vidcam''' was a device that could record audio and video. They could be placed on the outside of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], as well as inside a building or room.

==History==
When visiting [[Wald's Parts]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], were told by [[W. Wald|Wald]] that he overheard [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] talking about their new [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] using the vidcam in the corner of his ceiling. When the couple later stopped by the [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] [[Sidi Driss Inn]], they were told by [[Dama Whitesun Brunk]] that she had given [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that was linked to twenty different hidden vidcams that had been set up in the inn.<ref name="TatGhost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with vidcams, one of which was in the stern of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and was used to detect a [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[mapping skiff]] on the ''Falcon''{{'s}} tail when Han and Leia were scanning a planet to relocate the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] people to after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Leia later used the ''Falcon''{{'s}} vidcams to see movement on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near the [[Lizil]] nest in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="DNI: TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

During the [[Swarm War]], Han and Leia borrowed a [[Dray-class transport|''Dray''-class transport]], the ''[[Swiff]]'', from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and used its vidcams when they were once again at the Lizil nest. When taken aboard a [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss]] ship and interrogated by [[Baltke]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], Leia was being recorded by a hidden vidcam.<ref name="DNIII: TJK">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
